paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of performance scores for various language models on the MATH-500 and AIME24 benchmarks. The horizontal axis, labeled “Size (B),” represents the model size in billions of parameters, ordered from smallest (3B) to largest (7B), and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 95. The vertical axis, labeled “Score,” represents the performance score, with a scale ranging from 0 to 100, and is marked with integer tick labels. The bars represent the scores achieved by different models. The Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model is represented by a blue bar with a score of approximately 95 on both MATH-500 and AIME24, while the Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct model is depicted by a red bar with a score of approximately 97.3 on MATH-500 and 95.2 on AIME24. The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B model is shown by a purple bar, achieving a score of 90.8 on MATH-500 and 95 on AIME24. The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model is represented by a green bar, attaining a score of 79.8 on MATH-500 and 83.3 on AIME24. The o1-mini model is represented by a teal bar with a score of 74.6 on MATH-500 and 71.4 on AIME24, and the o1-preview model is depicted as a golden bar, scoring 63.6 on MATH-500 and 66.3 on AIME24.  The o1 model is shown as a sky blue bar with a score of 79.2 on MATH-500 and 80 on AIME24 and the DeepSeek-R1 model is depicted as a coral bar with a score of 44.6 on AIME24 and 83.3 on MATH-500. The bars are not sorted in a particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
